review_method: Read the complete production diff and all five new regression tests.
Verify legacy API wrappers, returned metadata and originating RetrievalCost semantics are preserved.
Check failure-path statement/row accounting and statement reset on cache reuse.
Require the receipt scope to exclude discarded generation retries and other unnamed work.
Verify the published source tree exactly equals the tested local source tree.

validation.clippy: cc-db and cc-search all targets; cc-eval p7_validation_work; -D warnings
validation.scope: author-executed scoped regression and root source review; no separately authored independent test suite

limits: Current final assembly attempt only; discarded generation retries are not aggregated.
Named manifest/identity and candidate projection SELECTs only; not total request SQL or I/O.
Existing output packing can omit detailed freshness metadata explicitly.
P7, public quality, V19 and 100k certification are not inherited.
